Definition: from G303 and G2064; to ascend:--go up.
BiblicalUsage: Paul uses this word for going up to Jerusalem, three years after his conversion, and Jesus goes up into a mountain to teach. The word is the plain act of ascending.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for going up carries no theology of its own; its use is geographical, that Jerusalem and the mountains of Galilee were reached by climbing.
